verdict.rationale: Together AI's Dedicated Model Inference (DMI) explicitly offers serving on reserved/dedicated GPUs isolated from the shared serverless pool, with no hard rate limits, and configurable autoscaling via replica limits, plus CLI deploy commands. This directly matches the story of isolating traffic on dedicated capacity with autoscaling. missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of autoscaling behavior in production and concrete latency/cost benchmarks vs serverless.
